sloka: त वयं भर्तुरादेशं बहुमान्य दृढव्रताः ।प्रविष्टाः स्म पुरा ऽदृष्टं वन गम्भीरदर्शनम् ।। ५.३३.३०।।।।
transliteration: ta vayaṁ bharturādeśaṁ bahumānya dṛḍhavratāḥ ।praviṣṭāḥ sma purā 'dṛṣṭaṁ vana gambhīradarśanam ।। 5.33.30।।।।

translations.english: "While the most valiant Rama was living in the Dandaka forest, I, his wife was borne away by the evilminded Ravana.
